subject.title: member-info fails with "fetch failed" on WSL2 in 2026.6.1 (SSRF fetch guard / undici dispatcher regression)

question: For this WSL2 Teams Graph failure, should OpenClaw preserve the current in-process SSRF DNS-pinning boundary and repair the Undici/Graph transport path, or wait for a broader approved egress-boundary change?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the live failure and repair choice cross the security boundary between Microsoft Graph auth, DNS pinning, proxy behavior, and Undici dispatcher policy.

options.title: Repair within guarded transport
options.body: Live-reproduce the Graph call and make the narrowest Teams Graph or shared guarded-fetch fix that preserves DNS pinning and current SSRF checks.

options.title: Use the broad egress refactor
options.body: Treat the egress refactor as the fix path only after it is merged with explicit security and compatibility approval plus Teams Graph proof.

options.title: Defer for more reporter proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or reporter can provide current WSL2 Teams Graph logs, then decide the transport shape from that evidence.

recommendation.title: Repair within guarded transport
recommendation.body: Live-reproduce the Graph call and make the narrowest Teams Graph or shared guarded-fetch fix that preserves DNS pinning and current SSRF checks.
